item.title: How Much Does Mobile App Development Cost in Australia in 2026?
item.summary: How much mobile app development costs depends on the complexity of the product, its features, platforms, integrations and the development team building it. A basic app can cost from around $5,000 to $50,000, while complex apps can exceed $250,000. Highly sophisticated platforms can push the cost of app development beyond $500,000.
